simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to עַד (H5706) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: עַד (ʻad) means booty First listed occurrence: Gen 49 27.

definitions.full: H5706. ad II. עַד noun [masculine] booty, prey (upon which one advances, falls ); **compare עֲדִי ᵑ7 booty , Isa 10:2 ; 33:23 +? עַד יאֹכַל Gen 49:27 devour prey (|| שָׁלָל ); מַרְבֶּה שָׁלָל עַד Isa 33:23 prey of great spoil ; לְעַד קוּמִי Zeph 3:8 (of God) my rising up to the prey (Br Mp ); עַד אֲבִי Isa 9:5 father i.e. distributor) of booty (Hi Kn Kue Br Mp Du Che Hpt ; > Ges Ew Di and others everlasting father ).
definitions.rootNote: the same as 5703 in the sense of the aim of an attack;
